_readme: Five test payloads covering all urgency levels, meeting types, and edge cases. Send each as a POST to your webhook URL.

examples._label: Test 1 — Standard demo request (expect: routine, classification: demo, ~60 min, video)
examples.reason: We want to see a live demo of your enterprise automation platform before making a procurement decision.

examples._label: Test 2 — Urgent support call, tomorrow (expect: urgent, priority_flag: true, ~45 min)
examples.reason: Our production integration broke overnight and we are losing transactions. Need a specialist call as soon as possible.

examples._label: Test 3 — Emergency escalation (expect: emergency, priority_flag: true, suggested morning slot)
examples.reason: CRITICAL: Our entire workflow automation suite is down and we have a board presentation in 3 hours. Need emergency assistance NOW.

examples._label: Test 4 — Onboarding session, out of hours (expect: routine, is_business_hours: false, slot suggestion)
examples.reason: Just signed up for the Pro plan and would love a walkthrough of the main features and best practices for our use case.

examples._label: Test 5 — Minimal data, vague date (expect: graceful fallback, validated_date: null or parsed, routine)
examples.reason: Would like to chat about your services.
